observations.reason: After the cleanup batch delivered, its active runtime stayed protected. A later cleanup from main removed that worktree but branch deletion failed because the shared hook still named its interpreter. This establishes a concrete residue path beyond the earlier inventory finding; it does not establish the historical cause of the 0.7.1 leftovers.
observations.summary: A shared commit hook can retain the removed batch interpreter during post-delivery cleanup

Retrying cleanup --all-delivered then removed the delivered loose batch branch with non-forced deletion, reporting no retained items. Reprepare main before final release cleanup; no installed Skill changes or forced deletion are needed. Product behavior remains the approved 0.7.2 scope.
